verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair privacy question for an email client, but nothing in the evidence documents any setting to disable Superhuman's own telemetry or usage tracking. The community comments about read-tracking pixels concern tracking of email recipients, not the user's product telemetry, so they do not apply to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
